pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions characterized by high-frequency edge oscillations and jagged, lobed perimeters. The dark regions exhibit a complex, non-geometric boundary with soft pixel gradients at the transition to the lighter background.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of light-toned negative space. Junction nodes are clearly visible as tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. The thickness of these pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, maintaining a clear topological separation between patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a short, vertical fringe with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations against the sky background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized dark, ovoid textural anomaly is present on the central mid-flank, appearing as a more densely pigmented or recessed area compared to the surrounding pelage pattern.
